capabilities: Look up readings and meanings of Japanese words, including inflected forms
Insert furigana for selected kanji expressions
Build, reorder, and sort glossaries of dictionary entries
Select sentences via one-click commands or hotkeys
Work with Japanese text in PDFs and on mobile
extras: Licensed under PolyForm-Perimeter v1.0.1; dictionary data derives from JMdict/EDICT and SudachiDict. Runs offline except for downloading or updating dictionary data. Roadmap lists coming and planned features (traditional kanji forms, text normalizer, kana-only lookup, glossary saving/loading).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Japanese dictionary lookup or furigana support, so working with Japanese text requires switching to external tools.

relations.evidence: To enable ruby rendering and editing you need to install Advanced Ruby as well.
The furigana insertion logic was inspired by the implementation in kuroshiro

summary: In-context Japanese language toolbox that looks up words, inserts furigana, builds glossaries, and selects sentences, running fully offline.
